items.title: Consume an Alcoholic Beverage
items.detail: Get from a C.A.M.P. Brewing Vat or another player's C.A.M.P.

items.title: Build a Generator in a C.A.M.P. or Workshop
items.detail: Open C.A.M.P. build menu, navigate to Power and place any Generator.

items.title: Collect Pre-War Money
items.detail: Check Shredder at C.A.M.P., or loot cash registers and safes at Camden Park or Wavy Willard's.

items.title: Collect a Plunger
items.detail: Search maintenance buildings at Whitespring Resort or restrooms at Wavy Willard's Water Park.

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Join or start a Daily Ops public team and complete the Daily Operation instance.

items.title: Kill a Super Mutant
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center for reliable spawns.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with any Energy Weapon
items.detail: Use Laser Rifles, Plasma Guns, Tesla Rifles, or similar at Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted weapons, junk, chems, or food to vendors at train stations.

items.title: Collect a Garden Gnome
items.detail: Find 5 gnomes at The General's Steakhouse walled garden in the Mire.

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops public team and complete 5 Daily Operations.

items.title: Complete a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Start at Highway Town Bounty Board and eliminate 10 assigned Outlaw enemies.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for dependable robot spawns.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest 30 from the wild or plant vegetables at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Wear any costume piece and kill 18 Phantoms from the Slasher event.

items.title: Kill a Scorched
items.detail: Kill 30 Scorched, with reliable spawns at Wavy Willard's Water Park.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft or scrap 15 bulk aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Hunt Spooky Scorched enemies wearing Halloween costumes and complete trick-or-treat challenges with other players' candy bowls.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this special weekend event.

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Earn double SCORE and extra caps during this bonus event.
